operations.name: read_pic_irr
operations.desc: Read Interrupt Request Register from master 8259 PIC
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov al, 0x0A
out 0x20, al
in al, 0x20
ret
operations.returns: IRR in AL (bit N = IRQ N pending)

operations.name: read_pic_mask
operations.desc: Read Interrupt Mask Register from master 8259 PIC
operations.returns: IMR in AL (bit N = IRQ N masked)
